base: black-and-white editorial vintage documentary photograph, desaturated, high contrast, grainy film texture. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Dense morning haze; the ENTIRE UPPER THIRD of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Subjects dark, low in the frame. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no modern cars, no modern machinery.

images.scene: A steep narrow street paved with old cobblestones (Brazilian paralelepipedo), camera placed extremely low, almost resting on the wet stones, looking down the slope. In the lower half of the frame, seen from BEHIND, three men in simple worn work clothes push an old 1970s Volkswagen Beetle downhill: bodies bent almost horizontal, shoulders and both hands pressed flat against the rear of the car, back legs stretched out, feet dug into the cobblestones. No faces visible. The Beetle sits a little ahead of them, dark, slightly tilted down the slope, its roof well below the middle of the frame. Plain bare house walls line both sides of the street. Further down, the street and the walls dissolve into the pale morning haze. Strong sense of effort and downhill motion. Nothing above the men and the car except empty haze.
